fact: A 29 July 2021 INTIC presentation states that the Strategic Plan for the Information Society presents 120 initiatives set out in a five-year Operational Plan, and lists monitoring and evaluation of all initiatives in 2021 as a perspective.
title: Política para a Sociedade de Informação de Moçambique e Lei das Transacções Electrónicas: Grau de Implementação, Desafios e Perspectivas
